state.description:
Saga lifecycle state. RECEIVED, UNFULFILLABLE and CANCELLED are
terminal; every other state is waiting for a next step.

transferLineId.description: The v1 single transfer line identifier (`<transfer_id>:1`).

reservationId.description: The origin reservation being released; present while the saga carries one (ALLOCATED and RELEASING answers, ADR 0022).

rejectionReason.description: Present only on a transfer inventory-storage refused (UNFULFILLABLE).
